### God Works for You
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/god-works-for-you
Passage: Psalm 121:1-3
Points:
- True help does not come from created things or earthly hills, but from the Creator who made them.
- God never slumbers, grows weary, or takes time off from caring for His people.
- The good news of the gospel is that God tirelessly works on behalf of those who trust Him.
- Trusting in God's ceaseless watchfulness replaces anxiety with enduring peace and joy.

### A Prayer for the Overwhelmed Heart
Author: Lekeisha Maldon
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/a-prayer-for-the-overwhelmed-heart.html
Passage: Psalm 121:1-2
Points:
- Experiencing seasons of overwhelm is a common human struggle, not a sign of spiritual failure.
- When trials feel heavy, believers should look upward to the Lord rather than fixate on surrounding problems.
- The God who created the mountains is vastly greater than any obstacle standing in the way.
- Relinquishing control to God and embracing community support frees us from the trap of self-sufficiency.
